svg.title: Cat flap gate - mechanical variants
svg.desc: Four concept sheets share a dimensioned front, top and side-view baseline. Variant 1 has separate actuation, sensing, and support/linkage layers; the third sheet shows the PCB and component keep-outs; the fourth places sensors relative to the PCB.

g.aria-label: Top-down tunnel view, narrower than the frame, with 165 millimetre clear passage and continuation break
g.title: Top-down tunnel view with continuation break

g.aria-label: Gate plane centered within the front frame
g.title: Flap panel seen from above

g.aria-label: Side section of frame and tunnel with continuation break
g.title: Side section of frame and tunnel with continuation break

g.aria-label: Gate plane seen from the side
g.title: Flap panel seen from the side
HS-0530B solenoids (left and right, side view)

g.aria-label: Guide bore, 6.6 millimetre bore with 4.4 millimetre top hole
g.title: Guide bore: constrains the latch to vertical travel

g.aria-label: Lock pins, 4 millimetre shaft with 6 millimetre piston, either side of the gate
g.title: Lock pins / latches (front and back of gate)

g.aria-label: Lock pin return springs, 0.4 by 5 by 20 millimetres
g.title: Return springs 0.4 x 5 x 20 mm (push lock pins up when unpowered)
Flap pivot rod Ø3 x 175 mm with knuckle

g.text: Components OK (both board faces, max 12.2 mm tall per side)
No components at latch bores or springs; PCB remains with 0.4 mm clearance per side

g.title: PCB, 165 x 21 mm, spans the inner frame width

g.aria-label: No components at the latch bores; PCB remains in place
g.title: No components at the latch bores; PCB remains with 0.4 mm clearance per side
